title: Replace stale source-line anchors in SCHC specifications
description: The reviewed SCHC docs still make exact-behavior claims through mutable source line anchors: spec/appendix-schc.md cites schc.h:93, constants.toml:29-36, and option.rs:33; spec/03-adaptation.md cites rules.py:290; draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md cites rules.rs:503 and :257. These anchors have already drifted (for example current Rule 7/specialized registry layout no longer corresponds to those numbers), so readers can be sent to unrelated definitions. Replace them with stable spec section/table names and file/module references while retaining independent normative text. Spec-only; no C/Zephyr work.
